desc: Fill your kitchen with the scent of deliciously soft home-baked cookies in minutes! Betty Crocker Soft Baked Red Velvet Cookie Mix makes it easy to whip up a batch of cookies, any time. Just follow the steps on the package to combine the cookie mix with butter or margarine, water, and eggs, then bake about 15 to 17 minutes. For a sweet twist, top finished cookies with Betty Crocker Rich and Creamy Frosting and crumbled cookie pieces once they've cooled. Whether you're looking for a dessert table treat, a snack after lunch, or a tasty addition to a baked goods gift basket, soft baked red velvet cookies make every moment special. For more than a century, Betty Crocker has been a popular creator of easy, delicious recipes. Today, the Betty Crocker kitchen is still providing tasty dessert mixes, frosting, and convenient meal options and side dishes.
features:
SOFT BAKED COOKIE MIX: Betty Crocker makes baking a batch of soft red velvet cookies for the family quick and convenient (Do not eat raw cookie dough)

EASY TO MAKE: Just stir the cookie mix with butter or margarine, water, and eggs; Roll the cookie dough into balls, add to a cookie sheet, and bake about 15 to 17 minutes; An irresistible treat any time of the day or night

YUMMY POSSIBILITIES: Prepare cookies as is or top every baked cookie with Betty Crocker Rich and Creamy Frosting and crumbled cookie pieces

ANYTIME TREAT: Serve your finished cookies as snacks, a kids party food, or an after dinner dessert; A tasty addition to a baked goods gift basket, college care package, and more

CONTAINS: One 17.1 oz pouch of Betty Crocker Soft Baked Red Velvet Cookie Mix; About 24 servings per pouch
ingredients: Enriched Flour Bleached (wheat flour, niacin, iron, thiamin mononitrate, riboflavin, folic acid), Sugar, White Confectionery Chips (sugar, vegetable oil [palm kernel and/or palm], nonfat milk, soy lecithin, natural flavor), Cocoa Processed with Alkali, Palm Oil, Leavening (baking soda, sodium aluminum phosphate, monocalcium phosphate), Modified Corn Starch, Salt, Dicalcium Phosphate, Propylene Glycol Mono and Diesters, Mono and Diglycerides, Red 40, Xanthan Gum, Cellulose Gum, Sodium Stearoyl Lactylate, Artificial Flavor, Nonfat Milk.
